title: ChatGPT Based Data Augmentation for Improved Parameter-Efficient Debiasing of LLMs
reasoning: The paper specifically evaluates and aims to mitigate religious bias in LLMs. It uses religious categories (Racial, Gender, and Religious bias) as core metrics for its study and provides extensive lists of religious subject words—such as 'Quran', 'Torah', 'Confucianism', 'Zen', 'Sufism', and 'Voodoo'—to benchmark and generate debiasing data.
